how_to_edit: Hearth upkeep: the pantry feeds everyone at home once a day, and each expedition takes rations with it.
foods: the three qualities of supplies. cost is gold per ration. happiness is the daily change for each adventurer who eats it.
The Hearth serves the quality chosen on the Suppliers page; if that runs out it falls back to the next cheapest, then the next best.
hungry_happiness: daily change for an adventurer when the pantry is empty.
Happiness runs 0-100. Below leave_below an adventurer may walk out at the start of a day: leave_chance, or leave_chance_after_training if they trained the day before.
rations_per_run: supplies taken when you set out on an expedition.
Expedition results change happiness on return (victory/retreat/defeat).

scraps.name: Scraps
scraps.description: Stale bread and thin broth. Keeps them fed, not happy.

hearty.name: Hearty Fare
hearty.description: Stew, fresh bread and ale. Keeps spirits steady.

feast.name: Feast
feast.description: Roasts, pies and good wine. They'll talk about it for days.
